owner_basis: Owner: proposed towns should not dwarf nearby marked places, inherently in the model; 'do what you think is right'. The A4 hierarchy model narrowly missed one held-out criterion (0.8% of subordinates larger than their centre vs 6.3% observed; limit 5 points) in the direction the owner asked for, and passed the others (capital factor 3.27 vs 3.22, median ratio 0.13 vs 0.11, KS 0.057, area ratio 1.01). Adopted on that basis; recorded as a narrow miss.
model: Size means: M1 (1.915 + 0.147 lnH, sigma 1.048) plus c = 0.8 for the 19 provincial seats (replaces the M1C capital term 1.255). Centres: all 151 marked places. Each proposed town belongs to its nearest marked place within 75 km. Residual draws as before (seed 1); each centre's residual is the largest of its own and those of half its cluster (members in a fixed seeded order). Areas from means + sigma x residual, clipped to 1-1783 ha.
kept: Owner rule A3 (strict lore order on final size among ranked marked places) and the capital rule (imperial capital and major imperial cities hold the largest areas of all towns). No other post-hoc swap.
report: Share of proposed towns larger than their marked place (before 249/582 corrected), totals, largest town, supply and staffing; publication through the chain if reviews pass.
